title: add-cosign-syft-release-manifests-and-provenance-for-private-installer
author: Maya Chen
description: Adds end-to-end release artifact provenance for the private-installer pipeline: SBOM (syft), signed artifacts (cosign), and generated release manifests consumed by the on-prem upgrade/rollback tooling. Motivation: customers running Private (VPC/on-prem) require verifiable provenance for installer artifacts to satisfy security/compliance audits and to enable safe automated upgrades. This PR wires syft to the existing CI build, publishes syft SBOMs alongside build artifacts, integrates cosign signing for images/artifacts produced by the installer pipeline, and generates release-manifests (YAML/JSON) that enumerate artifact digests, SBOM links, and signatures for the installer helm charts and terraform modules. The description below documents the scope, testing, and rollout checklist. Scope: - CI: add syft scanning step that produces SBOM tarballs and JSON, add cosign signing step for the installer tarballs, docker images and helm chart archives, and upload signatures alongside artifacts in the release bucket. - Release-manifests: generate a top-level release-manifest.json that includes artifact name, digest, SBOM URL, cosign signature URL, signing key ID and signing timestamp. - Installer: Helm chart changes to reference digest-pinned images and artifacts via the release-manifest during upgrades to support atomic rollouts/rollbacks. - Terraform module: include gated upgrade flag that uses release-manifest lookups for deterministic deploys. - Tooling: small CLI helper (scripts/release/manifest_tool.py) used by CI to format release manifests and validate provenance entries. How it works: the build job emits artifacts to the release bucket, then the syft step runs against built images/tars and writes SBOMs, cosign signs artifacts using an ephemeral CI key stored in GCP KMS (CI signs, then the signature is uploaded; the key never leaves KMS), and the manifest tool collates all items into a release-manifest.json. Security notes: cosign verification is required by downstream upgrade tooling before performing a cluster change. The cosign public keys are rotated via the existing key-management playbook; this PR adds metadata entries for key IDs in the release manifest. Testing: - CI verifies SBOMs exist and match artifacts via sha256 checksums. - Integration test runs a dry-upgrade using the generated manifest against a test cluster; installer validates signatures and SBOM presence before applying helm upgrades. - Manual verification steps were performed on staging. Rollout plan: 1) merge to main behind feature-flag gating in terraform/installer 2) run two canary private-installer upgrades in staging 3) verify audit logs and SBOM retrieval 4) enable for GA in next release. Checklist: [x] syft SBOM generation [x] cosign signing and signature uploads [x] manifest tool + manifest schema [x] helm chart digest pinning support [x] integration dry-upgrade test [x] docs + release notes

files_changed: release/manifest_tool.py (new CLI to generate and validate manifests)
review_comments: Liam O'Connor: Can we avoid exposing the cosign key id in the manifest? Suggest add a key_metadata block and ensure only the key fingerprint is included.
Maya Chen (author): Good point - switched to fingerprint + rotation URL instead of raw key id.
Priya Kapoor: Integration tests look good, but add a negative test where signature is missing to ensure failure path is enforced.
Maya Chen (author): Added test case for missing signature and validated CI fails the dry-upgrade.
Samir Patel: Verify that SBOMs do not contain PII from build environment. Please add scanning of SBOM outputs before upload.
Maya Chen (author): Added a SBOM scrub step to remove transient env fields and confirmed raw artifact names only.
merge_commit: Squashed commit: add release manifests, SBOMs and cosign signing for private-installer. Manifest tool collates artifact digests, SBOM links, and signatures for deterministic upgrades.
release_notes: Private-installer: CI now produces SBOMs (syft), cosign-signed artifacts, and a release-manifest.json that enumerates artifact digests, SBOM URLs, and signatures. Upgrade tooling now validates signatures and SBOM presence before applying changes.
change_log: CI: added syft SBOM generation for images and archives
CI: added cosign signing + signature upload for artifacts
Release: new release-manifest.json schema and generator
Installer: supports digest-pinned upgrades via release-manifest
Terraform: gating flag to opt into manifest-driven upgrades
notes_on_provenance: Manifest schema includes artifact_name, digest (sha256), sbom_url, signature_url, signing_key_fingerprint, signing_timestamp, and verification_status. The CI tool validates digests and attaches verification_status before publishing.
post_merge_actions: Backfill public cosign key into the key-management repo, schedule a canary upgrade in staging, and update the private-installer security playbook with manifest verification steps. Notify customers of provenance availability via docs and release notes.
